findings.description: Neighboring main-axis decimal tick labels run together in all three panels (117.0 through 130.5). Confirmed visually at full size and by concatenated decimal words in the corresponding PDF.
findings.disposition: Requires corrected saved-data rendering and fresh review; queued source repair does not retroactively qualify these bytes.

qualified_observations: All 194 contact images reviewed across all three clubs, both noise profiles, shaft-SD/curve conditions, and available lean cells.
Sampled captions disclose static loft, lean, target, path/speed/strike units and conditional valid/attempted counts.
Matrix labels disclose fixed-target control, Driver tee 400 m / 30 m fairway and approach green radius 15 m; unavailable cells remain visibly hatched with bounded-matching reasons.
Sampled density captions distinguish 600 displayed dots from all valid endpoints used by histogram/HDR/marginals; no empirical precision claim.
Sampled overheads disclose six displayed paths, support conditioning, raw target-frame geometry and lateral display magnification.
Direct social comparisons identify condition changes and shared axes/density scales.
limitations: Contact sheets screen the whole PNG set; representative full-size inspection is not exhaustive per-text bounding-box certification.
The 52-file PDF concatenated-word screen finds one suspect but does not prove a four-point gutter on every other tick pair.
This is graphics component review, not final narrative, supplemental pipeline or empirical model acceptance.
